name: Deftform
summary: Hosted form builder from Germany with unlimited responses and team members, conditional logic, file uploads, Stripe payments, webhooks and an API; priced per form, monthly or as a one-time lifetime licence.
best_for: small businesses, agencies and EU-based teams that want a clean hosted form builder with unlimited responses and team members, EU data storage and a choice between per-form, monthly or one-time pricing
skip_if: you need a large native integration catalogue (Mailchimp is still planned), enterprise compliance paperwork beyond ISO-certified hosting, or a published refund policy before you pay
honest_knock: The pricing is easy to misread: the home page says Deftform offers only pre-paid and lifetime options, while the pricing section also sells Complete at €25 a month, and Pre-paid forms come only in bundles of five. Lifetime does not include the Business add-on (enrichment, email verification, no backlink), which costs €18 a month on top, and a lifetime licence is only as durable as the company. Mailchimp is still listed as planned and the AI assistant as experimental. We found no published refund policy. Prices are in euros excluding VAT. We have not used Deftform ourselves.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-14 in a live browser on deftform.com, pricing section, and the legal notice) Three packages, base prices in euros excluding VAT, invoiced by a merchant of record. Pre-paid is €4 per form, bought in bulk quantities of 5, with no subscription. Complete is €25 a month with unlimited forms and the Business add-on included. Lifetime is €189 one-time for unlimited forms, or €16 a month for 12 months as an instalment plan. Every package includes unlimited responses, 3 workspaces, a custom domain with SSL, unlimited team members, unlimited file uploads (50 MB per file), payments via Stripe, custom CSS and JS, webhook and email notifications and API access. Add-ons for Pre-paid and Lifetime: Business at €18 a month (B2B data enrichment, email verification, data-retention control, selling multiple products, no backlink, no report badge, custom email domain), Extended at €19 one-time (multiple products, no backlink, no report badge, custom email domain) and backlink removal at €10 one-time. Extra workspaces are a one-time purchase. The first form is free to try.

compare_with.name: Gravity Forms
compare_with.why: Gravity Forms is in our dossiers too, re-verified on 23 September 2026: a WordPress plugin with annual licences from Basic at $59 a year for one site to Elite at $259. Deftform, read on 14 October 2026, is a hosted builder that works on any site, from €4 per form, €25 a month or €189 once, excluding VAT. On WordPress with your own hosting, Gravity Forms gives more control and add-ons; off WordPress, or if you want EU hosting handled for you, Deftform is the simpler buy. Currencies are not converted here.
